changed_in.5.2: Consults an `__ipairs` metamethod and hands back what that answers, so a value can offer an ordered walk of its own; 5.1 always walks the table's own positions.
changed_in.5.3: Looks each position up through the table's metamethods rather than reading it raw, so an `__index` can supply positions the table does not hold itself and the walk carries on past them. The call also stops insisting on a table: it hands back a walk for any value and leaves an indexing failure to the walk's first step, where 5.1 and 5.2 refuse a non-table at the call itself.
changed_in.5.4: Ignores `__ipairs`; a value that offered its own ordered walk that way gets the ordinary position-by-position one instead.
